question:
Fill in the blank with the correct synonym of the word "glib":

The speaker delivered an _______ speech, captivating the audience with her articulate words and passionate delivery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"glib"** means fluent and voluble but insincere and shallow. (चतुर और चालाक लेकिन ईमानदार नहीं)

 
 
• **Example: **His** glib** remarks made it clear that he was not taking the issue seriously.
 
 
 
• **"Eloquent" **means fluent or persuasive in speaking or writing; articulate. (प्रभावी वक्ता)
 
 
• **Example: **Her** eloquent** speech moved everyone to tears.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'glib' **in the given context is **'eloquent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Effluent **(अपशिष्ट जल): Liquid waste or sewage discharged into a river or the sea.

 
 
• **Example:** The factory was fined for releasing untreated effluent into the river.
 
 
 
• **Effulgent **(प्रभामंडल): Shining brightly; radiant.
 
 
• **Example: **She looked effulgent in her white wedding dress.
 
 
 
• **Elaborate** (विस्तृत): Involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated in design and planning.
 
 
• **Example:** The wedding decorations were elaborate, with flowers and lights everywhere.
 
 

 

31:Ta32,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
